lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with spot centroids to form a grid-like lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the upper flank defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient.
